name: Die. Alone?
source:
The medicine is deemed effective after series of experiments. The doctor is able to prove contact with the netherworld, erase a specimen's complete existence, and now to reach a status that might just make her above all things.

[From [url=https://niannn.itch.io/die-alone] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过一系列实验，该药被认为是有效的。医生能够证明与阴间的联系，消除了样本的完整存在，现在达到了一个可能让她凌驾于一切之上的地位。

[来自[url=https://niannn.itch.io/die-alone] itch.io[/url]]
